facts.fact: Brawley 昨夜在 Vero 房外走廊向 Kayla 讲解发作的来、去与应对边界
facts.anchor: Brawley explained it last night while we were sitting in the hallway

facts.fact: Kayla 摇头阻止 Bianca 叫保安，怕事态更糟
facts.anchor: I shake my head at her. Bruce won’t help this situation

facts.fact: 混乱中玻璃碎片割开 Kayla 手掌，她按着大腿说此刻不重要
facts.anchor: a clean slice from a shard that caught me in the chaos

facts.fact: Kayla 完全相信 Vero 关于镜面监视的说法，而这恰恰最糟
facts.anchor: I believe him, and that is the worst part

facts.fact: 她承认「不想他走」与「今晚只能赶他走」两者同时为真
Vero 跪进碎玻璃，Kayla 已无力叫他起身，只重复逐客令
facts.anchor: falling to his knees in front of me on the broken glass

facts.fact: 后间里 Kayla 给自己六十秒，如实感受全部痛苦再回到吧台
facts.anchor: I let it be as bad as it actually is instead of pretending it’s nothing

facts.fact: 章末 Kayla 定调：爱不能以他人的脸和老板的酒吧为代价
